title: Heiser affirms the Watchers and their giant offspring
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Heiser affirms the Watchers and their giant offspring, about antediluvian at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Heiser would have affirmed and did that the the Anakian tale that we talked about earlier

plain: A filmmaker who researches giants, Tim Alberino, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that Michael Heiser, a Bible scholar and author of books such as The Unseen Realm and Reversing Hermon, accepted the ancient story of the Watchers, heavenly beings said to have come down and fathered giants. Alberino says Heiser affirmed the tale of the Anakim, a race of giants named in the Bible. If true, giants born of non-human beings once walked the earth.
